messages.subject: 20kVA generator - delivery
messages.body:
Morning,

We need to book a 20kVA diesel generator and want it delivered to our site in Oulu. What options do you have for delivery?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator - delivery
messages.body:
Hi,

Thanks for getting in touch. I'll look into delivery scheduling for the 20kVA unit and let you know what we can do.

Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator - delivery
messages.body:
Marko,

Separate matter - booking RB-20265951, the 1-tonne mini dumper. We returned it late because our driver got stuck in traffic on the way back to the depot. The 300 EUR late return fee doesn't seem fair given the circumstances. Can that be waived?

Oulujoen Betonityö Oy
